# End of the World Atlas

> An independent cartographic project documenting Chilean Patagonia, Tierra del Fuego, Cape Horn and Chilean Antarctica through interactive maps, expedition routes and a lighthouse archive.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Cinematic gateway and overview of the Chilean austral frontier.
- [Atlas](/atlas): Interactive expedition atlas of the southernmost regions.
- [Routes](/routes): Premium expedition route guides with GPX tracks and field notes.
- [Lighthouses](/lighthouses): Archive of southern sentinels — Cabo de Hornos, Les Éclaireurs, Evangelistas and others.
- [Travel](/travel): Guided expeditions to Patagonia, Cape Horn and Chilean Antarctica.
- [About](/about): The project, the team and the editorial mission.
